description: This file contains unit tests for the DataReaderV1 class, which reads media segment data from shared memory buffers. It tests reading video and audio data segments, verifying data integrity and correct parsing.

classes.name: DataReaderV1Tests
classes.description: A Google Test fixture class for testing DataReaderV1's functionality, including setup, teardown, and specific read/write tests for video and audio data.

methods.name: writeVideoData
methods.description: Prepares and writes a video media segment into shared memory for subsequent reading.

methods.name: readVideoData
methods.description: Reads and verifies the video media segment data from shared memory.

methods.name: writeAudioData
methods.description: Prepares and writes an audio media segment into shared memory for subsequent reading.

methods.name: readAudioData
methods.description: Reads and verifies the audio media segment data from shared memory.
